messages:
jamie: Quick update — were opening a limited preview of MI600 Dedicated pools in Osaka and Madrid next week. Target start: Tue 09:00 JST / Mon 00:00 CET. This is a preview: capacity will be limited and gated to a small set of customers.

sara: Nice! Any notes on burst behavior / fairshare? Customers keep asking about unpredictable throttles. :thinking_face: 

jamie: Great question. Short version: burst enabled but capped per-customer to avoid noisy neighbors. Were introducing a new "burst_window" config (default: 5min) + a per-customer burst_token bucket. When tokens exhausted, requests are throttled to baseline throughput.

kevin: Added to console: a toggle in Dedicated > Pools > MI600 (preview) to opt into Burst Preview and set burst_window from UI. CLI sample: 
```
redwood pools reserve --pool mi600-osaka --capacity 4 --burst-window 300
```

devon: Runtime patch landed yesterday to support MI600 mixed-precision kernels. We validated 1.4x throughput on typical chat workload vs MI250x in our staging tests. Expect token-cost changes if teams switch models.

jamie: Billing note: preview customers billed at a reduced preview rate (50% list) but no SLA for this preview. When capacity becomes GA, billing and SLA will align with standard Dedicated tiers.

devon: Heads-up for infra teams: MI600 uses new driver stack; if youre running Private, you'll need driver v6.3.x+ and the runtime shim 2.1.0. We pushed a compatibility matrix in the runbook.

deploy-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mi600-dedicated-preview (internal) :link: 

kevin: Migration guidance for customers: start with small canary traffic, enable KV prefix caching, and set request_timeouts=120s for long-context models. We'll auto-route to fallback MI250x when MI600 is unavailable.

jamie: Capacity gating: PMs will nominate pilot customers. If youre owning a pilot, DM me the account id. Ops will provision daytime slots + nightly buffer for training runs.

sara: Any regressions we should watch for (quality or numeric)?

devon: Watch for fp16 numerical edge-cases with certain graph fusion ops; were tracking two regressions in the model-onboarding tracker. Tests include perf, token-accuracy on golden prompts, and kv-cache regressions.

jamie: TL;DR: MI600 preview in Osaka & Madrid next week, burst enabled but capped, preview billing, no SLA, console/CLI flags live, runbook link above. Please read runbook if youre supporting pilots and tag me with account ids. :rocket:
